description: What typing on the composition of composition.json produces, written by hand from the layers it takes (QWERTY base, AZERTY Shift, Ergopti AltGr, Ergo-L Shift+AltGr, the Ctrl shortcuts from AZERTY base, the Alt shortcuts from Ergo-L Shift) and its overrides. composed.keylayout is compiled from composition.json by tools/codegen/codegen-layout-composer-corpus.cjs. Presses and scan codes are those of keylayout_vectors.json; a shortcut vector names the held modifier (meta is Win/Cmd). Every driver's composer test replays this file through its own reader; the layout is registered under the id `composed` with the iso keycode convention.
